subject: general
question:
Eight politicians, Prudhvi, Samrat, Rajesh, Unadkat, Narayan, Vimal, Tapsvi and Wazid, are standing in a straight line facing north, but not necessarily in the same order. Rajesh and Wazid are the immediate neighbours of Samrat. Vimal is an immediate neighbour of Unadkat and Wazid. Tapasvi and Narayan are the immediate neighbours of Prudhvi. Neither Tapasvi nor Rajesh is at the extreme ends of the line. Unadkat is somewhere to the right of Tapasvi.

Who among the following is standing second to the right of Prudhvi?
solution:
Given: 

1) Rajesh and Wazid are the immediate neighbours of Samrat. 

2) Vimal is an immediate neighbour of Unadkat and Wazid.
